t: Mi shennitztarek lehatil mayim bishat qeria
s: Mi shennitztarek lehatil mayim bishat qeria ubo d' seipim: haya qore qeriat shema vehitchilu me raglayv shotetin al birkayv — poseq ad sheyyiklu lishtot, vechozer liqrot, apillu napelu al begadayv veyesh bahem topeach al menat lehatpiach, kevan shehem mekusim babbeged haelyon. Veim shaha kede ligmor et kullah — chozer larosh, kemo shennitbaer besiman s"h:

Veim napelu me raglayim baaretz — marchiq mehem d' ammot. Veim hu maqom sheyyekolin libbala baqqarqa bimhera — yakol lehamtin ad sheyyibbaleu, veen chosheshin shemma yishheh behamtana zo kede ligmor et kullah veyitztarek lachazor larosh, lepi sheap im yihyeh ken — en kan issur bammeh sheqqore qeriat shema b' peamim, mippene shehu keqore battora (umikkol maqom lekattechilla en lishhot kol kak, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman p"h). Abal im era ken kesheomed battepilla — lo yamtin ad sheyyibbaleu, ki shemma yishheh kede ligmor et kullah veyitztarek lachazor larosh veyigrom beraka sheenah tzerika, ella yarchiq d' ammot o yetze lecheder acher veyigmor sham tepillato:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshebbigdo haelyon naqi umekasseh al me raglayim shennapelu al begadim hattachtonim, abal im likluk me raglayim shebbibgadayv hu megulleh, sheap im yirchaq d' ammot lo yitpallel binqiyyut — lo yapsiq tepillato kelal, ella gomerah bemaqom sheomed sham ap al pi shemme raglayv megullin. Veen tzarik lehachalip begadayv apillu yesh lo, shekkevan shelleachar shennapelu mimmennu me raglayv en issuran ella middibre soperim — lo hitrichuhu lehapsiq tepillato velilbosh begadim acherim, kevan shehu omed kebar bitpillato sheasur lehapsiq bah bilbishat habbeged. Vegam im ba lehachamir al atzmo — eno rashshay. Mah sheen ken beharchaqat d' ammot keshebbigdo haelyon naqi — en bah torach kelal (vegam enah chashuba hepseq kol kak kemo lebishat beged):

Mi sheyyesh lo choli shemmetaptep tamid me raglayim leonso, veim ken lo yukal lehitpallel leolam — yaaseh lo beged sebib ebaro, kede shebbegadim haelyonim yihyu neqiyyim veyikkanes lebet hakkeneset veyitpallel. Ubishat hattapat me raglayim — yapsiq veachar kak yachazor lemaqom sheppasaq, raq yizzaher shello yatchil lehitpallel keshehutzrak kebar letaptep. Veap al pi sheyyodea shebbetok tepillato yitztarek letaptep — en bekak kelum, kevan shei epshar lo lehamtin ad sheyyittaher (ayyen siman p'):
